findings.title: API client turns an envelope with data:null into the envelope object; /jobs/report crashes for every user with no report (both brands, 3 agents)

findings.observed: Error boundary replaces the page; console 'IntlError: FORMATTING_ERROR: Invalid time value at ReportPage'. Fix by detecting the envelope ('success' in data / 'data' in data) instead of `??`. Screens: .verify/ra-jobs-tracker/33--jobs-report.png, .verify/goapply/shots/jobs-report-crash.png.

findings.title: Confirm headline 'We found N jobs that fit you - counts jobs at Good fit or better' is not a fit count; it flips between numbers and shows 1,586 for a user with no resume (D3)

findings.expected: One stable number that really is the count at Good fit or better (from the onboarding match result), or wording 'jobs match your search'; never called a fit when no resume was compared.
findings.evidence: Confirmed: ConfirmStep.tsx:76-78 uses `useFilterCount({...filters, fitTier:'good'})` and falls back to matched.jobCount; server/src/features/feed/sql.ts:315 treats fitTier as view-only (never SQL), so the count is the unfiltered search size. Fix inside this group: take the count from the onboarding match result (match.ts) and change the wording when nothing was compared. Screens shots/06-confirm-initial-1280.png, shots/15-skip-confirm-1280.png.

findings.title: First-visit tour never appears and onboarding stays at stage 'tour' (popup gate drops the grant when the mount effect runs twice)
findings.repro: Finish /onboarding/confirm with 'Show my jobs' -> /jobs. Wait 15 s, reload, wait again.
findings.observed: No dialog; /auth/me.onboarding stays {step:'tour', completed:false}; POST /onboarding/complete never fires; the tips dock that needs completed=true never unlocks.

findings.evidence: Confirmed in lib/ui/popupGate.ts: decide() (line 111-142) resolves one winner per batch; usePopupGate (line 241-248) sets live=false on cleanup, so under React strict mode (next.config.mjs reactStrictMode) the first request wins with live=false and the second request of the same key is resolved false. Agent's browser-side patch granting the second request showed the tour and completed onboarding. Likely dev-only, but any effect re-run inside the window loses the grant; verify on a production build too. Screens shots/07-jobs-tour-1280.png, shots/08-tour-1280-light.png.

Set client-level transactionOptions (maxWait/timeout) in prisma.ts and keep credit reserve/commit transactions short. Part of the latency (10 s /auth/me, 5-20 s saves) is this stack's Neon branch and is not a code defect. Callers in other groups (onboarding repo G2, copilot store G5, jobs import G3) need no change if the default is raised; G4 should log fixIssue failures.
